examples.text: ṭhite majjh'anhike kāle, sannisīvesu pakkhisu, saṇat'eva brah'āraññaṃ, taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti man'ti.
sabbe saṅgamma mantetvā, māḷaṃ kubbanti satthuno, ekatthambhaṃ alabhantā, vicinanti brahāvane.
phuṭṭho ḍaṃsehi makasehi, araññasmiṃ brahāvane, nāgo saṅgāmasīs'eva, sato tatr'ādhivāsaye.
yathā brahmā tathā eko, yathā devo tathā duve, yathā gāmo tathā tayo, kolāhalaṃ tat'uttarin'ti.
brahmā'ti, bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ… taṃ kissa hetu? bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro'ti.
bāhitvā sabbapāpakāni, vimalo sādhusamāhito ṭhit'atto, saṃsāram'aticca kevalī so, asito tādi pavuccate sa brahmā.
brahm'ujugatto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
idam'pi, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti, yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti.
tiṭṭhañ'caraṃ nisinno vā, sayāno vā yāvat'assa vigatamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāraṃ idha'm'āhu.

48908.meaning2: belonging to the company of Brahma

examples.text: paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā brahmakāyikā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ, suladdhalābhā vajjipajāya, yattha tathāgato viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
so tadassādeti, taṃ nikāmeti, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati. tattha ṭhito tadadhimutto tabbahulavihārī aparihīno kālaṃ kurumāno brahmakāyikānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

48909.meaning1: created by god; made by Brahma
48909.commentary: (DNa) issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttan'ti issarakataṃ brahmakataṃ, issaranimmitaṃ brahmanimmitan'ti attho. brahmā eva hi ettha ādhipaccabhāvena issaro'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, kathaṃvihitakaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto issarakuttaṃ brahmakuttaṃ ācariyakaṃ aggaññaṃ paññapethā'ti?

48910.meaning1: who criticizes god; who finds fault with Brahma

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtagarahakā bhūtajigucchakā, devagarahakā devajigucchakā, pajāpatigarahakā pajāpatijigucchakā, brahmagarahakā brahmajigucchakā

48911.meaning2: having a sound similar to that of Brahma

examples.text: dasabalasamannāgato, bhikkhave, tathāgato catūhi ca vesārajjehi samannāgato āsabhaṃ ṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti, parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati, brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti

48913.meaning1: spiritual path; spiritual practice; holy life
48913.commentary: (VIN) app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ, samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ, sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ, tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti
ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

48914.meaning1: related to the spiritual path; about the spiritual practice; regarding the holy life; about celibacy

examples.text: tasmā have lokavidū sumedho, lok'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsīsati lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.

48915.meaning1: discussion about the incomplete spiritual life, etc.

48916.meaning1: purpose of the spiritual path; goal of the holy life

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, brahmacariy'attho? yo kho, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, brahmacariy'atthoti.

48917.meaning2: difficulty of the spiritual life; suffering of the holy life

48918.commentary: (KVt) manussā ekaṃ vā bahū vā bhikkhū brahmacariyā cāvetu'kāmā gaṇhanti, ayaṃ brahmacariy'antarāyo.

examples.text: ayaṃ kakkhaḷo pharuso jīvit'antarāyaṃ vā brahmacariy'antarāyaṃ vā karissatī'ti n'āroceti, aññe patirūpe bhikkhū apassanto n'āroceti, nachādetu'kāmo n'āroceti, paññāyissati sakena kammenā'ti n'āroceti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

48919.meaning1: finding support in the holy life
48919.commentary: (ANa) brahmacariyaparāyaṇo'ti maggabrahmacariyaparāyaṇo. iminā lok'uttaro aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo kathito'ti.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ bhabbo eta'r'ahi, kāmāni paṭisevituṃ, anivatti bhavissāmi, brahmacariyaparāyaṇo'ti.

48920.meaning1: finding support in the holy life; (or) living the holy life destined for Nibbāna

examples.text: ahañ'ca sīlasampanne, cirarattasamāhite, sammāpabbajite vande, brahmacariyaparāyane.

48921.meaning1: perfection of the holy life; ideal of the spiritual path; culmination of the holy life

examples.text: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto nacirass'eva, yass'atthāya kulaputtā samma'd'eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.

48922.meaning1: personal experience of the culmination of the spiritual path

48923.meaning1: fruit of the spiritual path; result of the holy life

examples.text: katamāni ca, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaphalāni? sot'āpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ, imāni vuccanti, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaphalānī'ti.

48924.meaning1: led the spiritual life; lived the holy life
48924.meaning2: led the spiritual life; lived the holy life

examples.text: rājā kho pan'ānanda, maghadevo caturāsītivassasahassāni kumārakīḷitaṃ kīḷi, caturāsītivassasahassāni oparajjaṃ kāresi, caturāsītivassasahassāni rajjaṃ kāresi, caturāsītivassasahassāni imasmiṃ'y'eva maghadevaambavane agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito brahmacariyam'acari.
te tositā cakkhumatā, buddhen'ādiccabandhunā, brahmacariyam'acariṃsu, varapaññassa santike.

48925.meaning1: in conformity with the spiritual path; proper for the holy life

examples.text: yāni ca kho tāni sikkhāpadāni ādibrahmacariyakāni brahmacariyasāruppāni tattha dhuvasīlo ca hoti ṭhitasīlo ca, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.

48927.meaning1: living the holy life; following the spiritual path; who is celibate renunciant

examples.text: kāmesu brahmacariyavā, vītataṇho sadā sato, saṅkhāya nibbuto bhikkhu, tassa no santi iñjitā.
yodha puññañ'ca pāpañ'ca, bāhetvā brahmacariyavā, saṅkhāya loke carati, sa ve bhikkhū'ti vuccati.

48928.meaning1: living the holy life; following the spiritual path
48928.commentary: (SNa) na y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyethā'ti ayaṃ maggabrahmacariyavāso nāma na paññāyeyya. maggo hi tebhūmakasaṅkhāre vivaṭṭento uppajjati. yadi ca ettako attabhāvo nicco bhaveyya, maggo uppajjitvā'pi saṅkhāravaṭṭaṃ vivaṭṭetuṃ na sakkuṇeyyā'ti brahmacariyavāso na paññāyetha.

examples.text: ettako ce'pi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, na'y'idaṃ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.

yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yath'āyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti, evaṃ santaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyavāso na hoti, okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.

48929.meaning1: lives the holy life; walks the spiritual path; follows a religion

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāme ca nappaṭisevati, pāpañ'ca kammaṃ na karoti, sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena assumukho'pi rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati.

tena kho pana samayena sabhiyassa paribbājakassa purāṇasālohitāya devatāya pañhā uddiṭṭhā honti, yo te, sabhiya, samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ime pañhe puṭṭho byākaroti tassa santike brahmacariyaṃ careyyāsī'ti.

48930.meaning1: spiritual path; spiritual practice; holy life; celibacy
48930.commentary: (MNa) brahmacariyan'ti dānam'pi veyyāvaccam'pi sikkhāpadam'pi brahmavihārā'pi dhammadesanā'pi methunavirati'pi sadārasantoso'pi uposatho'pi ariyamaggo'pi sakalasāsanam'pi ajjhāsayo'pi vīriyam'pi vuccati. (ANa) brahmacariyan'ti ariyamaggasīlaṃ.

examples.text: acaritvā brahmacariyaṃ, aladdhā yobbane dhanaṃ, jiṇṇakoñcā'va jhāyanti, khīṇamacche'va pallale.

48931.meaning1: support for the spiritual practice; help for the holy life

examples.text: paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āharissāma n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya

48932.grammar: masc, comp, dat sg of brahmacariyānuggaha
48932.meaning1: to support the spiritual practice; to help the holy life

examples.text: n'eva davāya, na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya

48933.meaning1: seeking renunciation; seeking a spiritual path
48933.commentary: (ANa) brahmacariyaṃ esissāmi gavesissāmī'ti evaṃ pavatt'ajjhāsayasaṅkhātā brahmacariy'esanā'pi arahattamaggen'eva paṭippassaddhiṃ vūpasamaṃ gacchati. diṭṭhibrahmacariy'esanā pana sot'āpattimaggen'eva paṭippasambhatī'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: kathañ'c'āvuso, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭh'esano hoti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno kām'esanā pahīnā hoti, bhav'esanā pahīnā hoti, brahmacariy'esanā paṭippassaddhā.
kām'esanā bhav'esanā, brahmacariy'esanā saha, iti saccaparāmāso, diṭṭhiṭṭhānā samussayā.

48934.commentary: (DNa) tattha katamā brahmacariy'esanā? sassato loko'ti vā… n'eva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇā'ti vā, yā evarūpā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ vipariyesaggāho, ayaṃ vuccati brahmacariy'esanā'ti evaṃ vuttā diṭṭhigatikasammatassa brahmacariyassa gavesanadiṭṭhi brahmacariy'esanā nāma.

48935.meaning1: immersed in the spiritual path; absorbed in spiritual practice
48935.commentary: (SNa) brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ sukhan'ti brahmacariyaṃ ogāhitvā ṭhitaṃ uparimaggattayasampayuttaṃ sukhaṃ. (ANa) anuttaraṃ brahmacariy'ogadhan'ti arahattamaggasaṅkhātassa brahmacariyassa anuttaraṃ ogadhaṃ uttamapatiṭṭhābhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ. (ANt) maggabrahmacariyassa ogadhaṃ mūlaṃ patiṭṭhābhūtaṃ brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ. ten'āha arahattamaggasaṅkhātassā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: yesaṃ saddhā ca sīlañ'ca, pasādo dhammadassanaṃ, te ve kālena paccenti, brahmacariy'ogadhaṃ sukhan'ti.

48936.meaningLit: discourse on immersed in the spiritual path

48937.commentary: (ANa) apace brahmacārayo'ti brahmacārino apacayati, nīcavuttitaṃ nesaṃ āpajjati.

examples.text: yasmiṃ padese kappeti, vāsaṃ paṇḍitajātiyo, sīlavant'ettha bhojetvā, saññate brahmacārayo.

48938.meaning1: excessive desire of the spiritual practitioner; (comm) longing for the requisites of others

examples.text: yañ'hi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhipatthanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhipatthanenā'ti, eta'r'ahi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhipatthanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhipatthanenā'ti.
tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya. yañ'hi taṃ, kassapa, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacār'ūpaddavena abhibhavanā brahmacārī brahmacāri-abhibhavanenā'ti

48940.meaning1: celibate woman; living the holy life; following the spiritual path
48940.commentary: (THIa) sotthi siyā brahmacārinī'ti seṭṭhacārini mahesike tuyhaṃ ārogyam'eva bhaveyya.

examples.text: tassa ca viramāsi tāva'd'e, rāgo tattha khamāpayī ca naṃ, sotthi siyā brahmacārinī, na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati.

48941.meaning1: pretending to be celibate; claiming to be chaste

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.

48942.meaning1: celibate; chaste; abstaining from sexual intercourse; holy
48942.commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) brahmacārin'ti methunadhammā paṭivirataṃ. (MNa) brahmaṃ seṭṭhaṃ paṭipadaṃ carantī'ti brahmacārī, methunā paṭiviratā'ti attho.

examples.text: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ahosiṃ ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
alaṅ'kato ce'pi samaṃ careyya, santo danto niyato brahmacārī, sabbesu bhūtesu nidhāya daṇḍaṃ, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhu.

48943.meaning1: celibate man; who abstains from sexual intercourse

examples.text: etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā'ti methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.
idha ekacco dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asucisaṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño antopūti avassuto kasambujāto, antopūtibhāvo'ti.

48944.meaning1: living the holy life; following the spiritual path

examples.text: araññe viharantānaṃ, santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ, ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, kena vaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti.

48945.meaning1: risk for one's celibacy; danger to the holy life
48945.commentary: (MNa) ācariy'ūpaddavenā'ti abbhantare uppannena kiles'ūpaddavena ācariyass'upaddavo. ses'upaddavesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: tatr'ānanda, yo c'ev'āyaṃ ācariy'ūpaddavo, yo ca antevās'ūpaddavo ayaṃ tehi brahmac'ārūpaddavo dukkhavipākataro c'eva kaṭukavipākataro ca, api ca vinipātāya saṃvattati.

48946.meaning1: born from Brahma; made by god

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.
brahmajacco pure āsiṃ, udicco ubhato ahu, sojja putto sugatassa, dhammarājassa satthuno.

ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.
yāni c'imāni dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhigatāni brahmajāle bhaṇitāni, imā nu kho, bhante, diṭṭhiyo kismiṃ sati honti, kismiṃ asati na hontī'ti?
idaṃ padaṃ brahmajālasutte na dissati.

48951.meaning1: who is repulsed by god; who is disgusted with god

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtagarahakā bhūtajigucchakā, devagarahakā devajigucchakā, pajāpatigarahakā pajāpatijigucchakā, brahmagarahakā brahmajigucchakā

48953.meaning1: Brahmanhood; being a true Brahman; being a holy person

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, dukkaraṃ, bho gotama, sāmaññaṃ dukkaraṃ brahmaññan'ti.
pabbajjā, bho, app'esakkhā ca appalābhā ca, brahmaññaṃ mah'esakkhañ'ca mahālābhañ'cā'ti. mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha, pabbajjā app'esakkhā ca appalābhā ca, brahmaññaṃ mah'esakkhañ'ca mahālābhañ'cā'ti.
katamāni ca, bhikkhave, brahmaññaphalāni? sot'āpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ, imāni vuccanti, bhikkhave, brahmaññaphalānī'ti.

48955.construction:
√brah + ma + na + ya + tā
brahmañña + tā

examples.text: sukhā matteyyatā loke, atho petteyyatā sukhā, sukhā sāmaññatā loke, atho brahmaññatā sukhā.

48956.meaning1: goal of being a Brahman; purpose of Brahmanhood; epithet of Nibbāna
48956.commentary: (SNa) sāmaññ'atthaṃ vā brahmaññ'atthaṃ vā'ti ettha ariyamaggo sāmaññañ'c'eva brahmaññañ'ca. ubhay'atthā'pi pana attho nāma ariyaphalaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: na ca pana te āyasmanto sāmaññ'atthaṃ vā brahmaññ'atthaṃ vā diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.

48957.meaning1: fruit of the spiritual path; result of the holy life

examples.text: katamāni ca, bhikkhave, brahmaññaphalāni? sot'āpattiphalaṃ, sakadāgāmiphalaṃ, anāgāmiphalaṃ, arahattaphalaṃ, imāni vuccanti, bhikkhave, brahmaññaphalānī'ti.

48958.meaning1: considered (the definition of) Brahmanhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) being a Brahman
48958.meaning2: considered (the definition of) Brahmanhood; reckoned as (fundamental to) being a Brahman

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ime'pi kho, āvuso gotama, tapopakkamā etesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ sāmaññasaṅkhātā ca brahmaññasaṅkhātā ca.
bhavañ'hi soṇadaṇḍo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahm'aḍḍhī, brahmavaccasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya…

48962.meaning1: godliness; state of being god; fact of being the creator

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… bhūtānaṃ bhūtattena ananubhūtaṃ, devānaṃ devattena ananubhūtaṃ, pajāpatissa pajāpatittena ananubhūtaṃ, brahmānaṃ brahmattena ananubhūtaṃ

48963.meaning1: (vinaya) punishment by not admonishing, instructing or communicating with the offender
48963.meaning2: punishment involving no admonishment or communication
48963.commentary: (DNt) brahmadaṇḍenā'ti bhikkhūhi itthan'nāmo n'eva vattabbo, na ovaditabbo, nānusāsitabbo'ti (cūḷava. 445) katena brahmadaṇḍena.

examples.text: yadaggena tayā, āvuso channa, arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ tadaggena te brahmadaṇḍo paṭippassaddho'ti. imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā pañca bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ. tasmā ayaṃ vinayasaṅgīti pañcasatikā'ti vuccatī'ti.

48964.meaning1: severe punishment; highest penalty; a Brahman's curse

examples.text: atha kho tassa rājā okkāko bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto brahmadaṇḍena tajjito maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ adāsi.

48965.meaningLit: given by god; (or) protected by god

examples.text: atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kāsigāmake kumbhakārakule nibbattitvā kumbhakārakammaṃ katvā puttadāraṃ posesi.

48966.meaningLit: given by god; (or) protected by god

examples.text: kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa brahmadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi. dhanavatī nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti.

48967.meaning1: name of one the seven Bharata kings
48967.meaningLit: given by god; (or) protected by god

examples.text: sattabhū brahmadatto ca, vessabhū bharato saha, reṇu dve dhataraṭṭhā ca, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā'ti.

brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.

48971.meaningLit: gift to Brahmans; (or) gift from god
48971.commentary: (MNa) brahmadeyyan'ti seṭṭhadeyyaṃ, chattaṃ ussāpetvā rājasaṅkhepena bhuñjitabban'ti attho. atha vā… brahmadeyyan'ti seṭṭhadeyyaṃ, yathā dinnaṃ na puna gahetabbaṃ hoti nissaṭṭhapariccattaṃ, evaṃ dinnan'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.

48972.meaning2: personal name of an arahant monk

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena aññatarissā brāhmaṇiyā brahmadevo nāma putto bhagavato santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti.
iti h'idaṃ mārassa ca anālapanatāya brahmuno ca abhinimantanatāya, tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa brahmanimantanikaṃ't'eva adhivacanan'ti.

brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evam'āhaṃsu, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇo'va sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo, brāhmaṇā'va sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā, brāhmaṇā'va brahmuno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimmitā brahmadāy'ādā'ti.

48977.meaning1: who has attained holiness; become divine; (comm) become foremost

examples.text: isisattamassa akuhassa, tevijjassa brahmapattassa, nhātakassa padakassa, passaddhassa viditavedassa, purin'dadassa sakkassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

48978.meaning1: attainment of holiness; attaining the highest state

examples.text: saccaṃ dhammo saṃyamo brahmacariyaṃ, majjhe sitā brāhmaṇa brahmapatti, sa t'ujjubhūtesu namo karohi, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ dhammasārī'ti brūmī'ti.

48979.commentary: (THa) iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe'ti catubbidhe'pi brahmavihārapathe, brahme vā seṭṭhe phalasamāpattipathe samāpajjanavasena pavattamānaṃ. (ANa) brahmapathe'ti seṭṭhapathe, amatapathe, nibbānapathe.

examples.text: manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ, attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ, iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe, cittass'ūpasame rataṃ.
nanu tvaṃ, bhikkhu, passasi brahmaparisaṃ sannipatitan'ti? iti kho maṃ, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā brahmaparisaṃ upanesi.
yo c'eva, pāpima, brahmā, yā ca brahmaparisā, ye ca brahmapārisajjā, sabb'eva tava hatthagatā sabb'eva tava vasaṃgatā.

48981.meaning1: who praises god; who approves of god

examples.text: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtapasaṃsakā bhūt'ābhinandino, devapasaṃsakā dev'ābhinandino, pajāpatipasaṃsakā pajāpat'ābhinandino, brahmapasaṃsakā brahm'ābhinandino, te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.

48982.meaning1: member of god's assembly; member of Brahma's council

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā aññataraṃ brahmapārisajjaṃ anvāvisitvā maṃ etadavoca, bhikkhu, bhikkhu, m'etam'āsado m'etam'āsado
yo c'eva, pāpima, brahmā, yā ca brahmaparisā, ye ca brahmapārisajjā, sabb'eva tava hatthagatā sabb'eva tava vasaṃgatā.
tesaṃ, bhante, gopakena devaputtena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭh'eva dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ, eko pana devo kāme ajjhāvasi.

48984.meaning1: who has become a god; (comm) reborn as a Brahma and attained arahantship from there
48984.commentary: (ANa) brahmappattā'ti niddos'aṭṭhena brahmabhāvasādhakaṃ brahmavihāraṃ brahmavihārena ca arahattaṃ pattā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe āneñjappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ariyappattā viharanti.

48985.meaning1: nominal Brahman; Brahman merely by birth
48985.meaning2: relative of the Brahma; i.e. a Brahman

examples.text: na āmagandho mama kappatī'ti, icc'eva tvaṃ bhāsasi brahmabandhu, sālīnam'annaṃ paribhuñjamāno, sakuntamaṃsehi susaṅkhatehi, pucchāmi taṃ kassapa etam'atthaṃ, kathaṃ pakāro tava āmagandho.
brahmabandhu pure āsiṃ, ajj'amhi saccabrāhmaṇo, tevijjo vedasampanno, sottiyo c'amhi nhātako'ti.
dūre ito brāhmaṇi brahmaloko, yassāhutiṃ paggaṇhāsi niccaṃ, n'etādiso brāhmaṇi brahmabhakkho, kiṃ jappasi brahmapathaṃ ajānaṃ.
so h'āvuso, bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto, vattā pavattā, atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā, dhammassāmī tathāgato
so n'eva attan'tapo na paran'tapo diṭṭh'eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhappaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
uḷāro so kaṇho isi ahosi. so dakkhiṇajanapadaṃ gantvā brahmamante adhīyitvā rājānaṃ okkākaṃ upasaṅkamitvā maddarūpiṃ dhītaraṃ yāci.
brahmayānarūpaṃ vata, bho'ti!! sakkā nu kho, bhante, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmayānaṃ paññāpetun'ti?

48992.meaning1: epithet of the Noble Eightfold Path
48992.commentary: (SNa) ayañ'hi sabbadosavigamena seṭṭho, iminā ca ariyā nibbānaṃ yantī'ti brahmayānaṃ iti'pi

examples.text: sakkā, ānandā'ti bhagavā avoca, imass'eva kho etaṃ, ānanda, ariyassa aṭṭh'aṅgikassa maggassa adhivacanaṃ, brahmayānaṃ iti'pi, dhammayānaṃ iti'pi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo iti'pī'ti.

48993.meaning1: vehicle suitable for Brahma; as if God's carriage

examples.text: tam'enaṃ jano disvā evam'āha, brahmaṃ vata, bho, yānaṃ! brahmayānarūpaṃ vata, bho'ti!!

48994.meaning1: leading to Brahma; going to the world of the gods

examples.text: atha kho so, kevaṭṭa, bhikkhu tathārūpaṃ samādhiṃ samāpajji, yathāsamāhite citte brahmayāniyo maggo pāturahosi.

48995.meaning1: Brahma's realm; world of the gods

examples.text: ayaṃ loko paro loko, brahmaloko sadevako, diṭṭhiṃ te n'ābhijānāti, gotamassa yasassino.

ko sujjhati muccati bajjhatī ca, ken'attanā gacchati brahmalokaṃ, ajānato me muni brūhi puṭṭho, bhagavā hi me sakkhi brahmajjadiṭṭho, tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.

48996.meaning1: leading to Brahma's realm; going to the world of the gods
48996.meaning2: leading to Brahma's realm; going to the world of the gods

examples.text: siyā nu kho, māṇava, tassa purisassa naḷakāragāme jātavaddhassa naḷakāragāmassa maggaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā'ti, na tv'eva tathāgatassa brahmalokaṃ vā brahmalokagāminiṃ vā paṭipadaṃ puṭṭhassa dandhāyitattaṃ vā vitthāyitattaṃ vā.

48997.meaning1: having Brahma's realm as ultimate goal; with the world of the gods as ultimate purpose
48997.commentary: (ANa) brāhmaṇānañ'ca, yaññaṃ yajissāmā'ti cittaṃ abhinivisati, brahmaloke patte pariyosānappattā nāma honti. tasmā te yaññābhinivesā brahmalokapariyosānā'ti vuttā.

48998.meaning1: teaching the path to Brahma's realm

48999.meaning1: companionship (with those in) Brahma's realm; company of (those in) the world of the gods
48999.commentary: (DNa) sāvakānañ'ca brahmalokasahabyatāya maggaṃ desesī'ti brahmaloke brahmunā sahabhāvāya maggaṃ kathesi.

examples.text: karuṇāsahagatena cetasā… muditāsahagatena cetasā… upekkhāsahagatena cetasā… abyāpajjena pharitvā vihāsi sāvakānañ'ca brahmalokasahabyatāya maggaṃ desesi.
